This file goes through all the processing and analysis of the PICO (2020 East Troublesome) data for the 2026 Annual Report. 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

#Step 1: Tidy the raw data exports from FFI and save as individual data frames for each protocol. 
*Note: For PICO 08, 09, 10, and 12, there are multiple reads prior to the one we did this summer, so I only kept the most recent previous read. 


Data tidying/formatting. Metadata is "Plot" i.e. PICO_09, "Status" i.e. Pre or Post, and "Burned2020" i.e. yes or no
  1. Fuels Report
  2. Tree report
  

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# Fuel Report
fuels_report <- read.csv("PICO/Report_SurfaceFuels_E.csv", skip = 2)

fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% slice(c(5:6, 11:12, 17:20, 24:43)) %>% select(-c(2, 10:46, 54)) %>% 
  mutate(Plot = str_replace(Macroplot, "^F([A-Z]+)\\d*T\\d+:(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2"),Plot = str_replace(Plot, "_(\\d)$", "_0\\1")) %>% 
  select(-Macroplot) %>% mutate(Status = rep(c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"), length.out = n())) %>% 
  select(-MonStatus) %>% mutate(Burned2020 = case_when(Plot == "PICO_08" ~ "no", Plot == "PICO_09" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_10" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_11" ~ "yes",
      Plot == "PICO_12" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_13" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_14" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_15" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_16" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_19" ~ "no", Plot == "PICO_20" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_21" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_24" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_25" ~ "no",TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% 
  rename(ThoHr_Snd = X.3_Snd,ThoHr_Rot = X.3_Rot) %>%  select(Plot, Status, Burned2020, everything())

write.csv(fuels_report, "2025 Annual Report Data/fuels_report.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Seedling Report
seedling_report <- read.csv("PICO/Report_DensityQuadrats_E.csv", skip = 2)
seedling_report <- seedling_report %>% slice(c(14:19, 33:39, 57:66, 76:123)) %>% 
  mutate(Plot = str_replace(Macroplot, "^F([A-Z]+)\\d*T\\d+:(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2")) %>% select(-Macroplot) %>% group_by(Plot) %>% 
  mutate( Status = if_else( MonStatusOrd == max(MonStatusOrd, na.rm = TRUE),"PostBurn","PreBurn")) %>% ungroup()
seedling_report <- seedling_report %>% mutate(Burned2020 = case_when(Plot == "PICO_08" ~ "no", Plot == "PICO_09" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_10"  ~ "yes", Plot == "PICO_11"  ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_12"  ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_13" ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_14"  ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_15"  ~ "no", Plot== "PICO_16"  ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_19"  ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_20"  ~ "yes",Plot == "PICO_21" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_24" ~ "no",Plot == "PICO_25" ~ "no", .default = NA))
seedling_report <- seedling_report %>% select(-MonStatusOrd, -MonStatus, -SizeCl, -AgeCl) %>% select(Plot, Status, Burned2020, everything())

write.csv(seedling_report, "2025 Annual Report Data/seedling_report.csv")

# Data Functions for loading raw FFI output data
# Header loading function
load_headers <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    file_data <- read.csv(file) %>% select(1:10) %>% filter(Visited == "True")
    file_data <- file_data %>% mutate(Comment = "")
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, data_list))
}

load_data <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    if (file.info(file)$size == 0) return(NULL)
    file_data <- tryCatch({
      read.csv(file, skip = 3) %>% mutate(Comment = "")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error reading file: ", file, " - skipping this file.")
      return(NULL)
    })
    return(file_data)
  })
  do.call(rbind, data_list[!sapply(data_list, is.null)])
}
  
directory_path <- "PICO/"

  # Overstory tree data

trees_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Trees - Individuals \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Trees - Individuals \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) 
trees_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
trees_headers <- do.call(rbind, trees_headers)  
trees_df <- left_join(x = trees_df, y = trees_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date"))

trees_df <- trees_df %>% select(-c(1, 4, 7, 13, 15:17, 23:27, 31:40))
trees_df <- trees_df %>%mutate(Plot = str_replace(MacroPlot.Name, "^F([A-Z]+)\\d*T\\d+:(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2"),
    Plot = str_replace(Plot, "_(\\d)$", "_0\\1") ) %>%select(-MacroPlot.Name)
  
burned_map <- c(
  "PICO_08" = "no", "PICO_09" = "no", "PICO_10" = "yes", "PICO_11" = "yes",
  "PICO_12" = "yes", "PICO_13" = "yes", "PICO_14" = "yes", "PICO_15" = "no",
  "PICO_16" = "yes", "PICO_19" = "no", "PICO_20" = "yes", "PICO_21" = "no",
  "PICO_24" = "no", "PICO_25" = "no")
trees_df <- trees_df %>%
  mutate(Burned2020 = burned_map[Plot])
trees_df <- trees_df %>%mutate(Status2 = if_else(str_detect(Sample.Event.Date, "2025"),"PostBurn","PreBurn"))

trees_df <- trees_df %>% select(-c(Sample.Event.Date, Break.Pnt..Dia.)) %>%  select(Plot, Status2, Burned2020, Plot.Area, Snag.Plot.Area, everything())

write.csv(trees_df, "2025 Annual Report Data/trees_data.csv")

###COME BACK TO TREE REPORT
# tree report
tree_report <- read.csv("PICO/Report_Trees_E.csv", skip = 2)
treeS_report <- read.csv("PICO/Report_TreesbySpecies_E.csv", skip = 2)
treeS_report <- treeS_report %>% select(-SciName, -CommName)
tree_report <- tree_report %>% slice(5:6, 11:12, 17:20, 24:43)
tree_report <- tree_report %>% mutate(Species = "All")
tree_report2 <- rbind(tree_report, treeS_report)
tree_report <- tree_report2 %>% select(-c(4:6, 13:21))
tree_report <- tree_report %>% rename(Live = Total)
tree_report <- tree_report %>% mutate(Total = Snag + Live)

tree_report <- tree_report %>% mutate(Macroplot = str_replace(Macroplot, "^F([A-Z]+)\\d*T\\d+:(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2")) %>% rename(Plot = Macroplot)
tree_report <- tree_report %>%mutate(Burned2020 = burned_map[Plot])

tree_report <- tree_report %>% mutate(Status = case_when(Plot %in% c("PICO_08", "PICO_10", "PICO_09", "PICO_12") & MonStatusOrd == 16 ~ "PostBurn",
                                                         Plot %in% c("PICO_11", "PICO_13", "PICO_14","PICO_15", "PICO_16", "PICO_19",
                                                                    "PICO_20", "PICO_21", "PICO_24", "PICO_25") & MonStatusOrd == 7 ~ "PostBurn", .default = "PreBurn"))

tree_report <- tree_report %>% select(-c(MonStatusOrd, MonStatus)) %>% select(Plot, Status, Burned2020, Species, Live, Snag, Total, everything())

write.csv(tree_report, "2025 Annual Report Data/tree_report.csv")
```

# Step 2: Tree Analyses

  1. Preliminary plotting of 2025 overstory data
  2. Statistical Analyses
  3. Comparisons with pre-burn data
  4. Tables/Figures/findings for Annual Report
  
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# 1
~~~~~~~~~~~~~
tree_report <- read.csv("2025 Annual Report Data/tree_report.csv")
tree_df <- read.csv("2025 Annual Report Data/trees_data.csv")

tree_df <- tree_df %>% filter(Status2 == "PostBurn")
tree_df <- tree_df %>% select(-c(1, 17:19)) %>% mutate(SizeClass = case_when(DBH >= 15 ~ "Overstory",
                                                                             DBH < 15 ~ "Pole", .default = NA))


# DBH distribution by status
ggplot(tree_df, aes(x = DBH, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") + facet_wrap(~ Plot) + 
  theme_minimal() + labs(x = "DBH (cm)", y = "Count", title = "DBH Distribution by Plot and Burn Status")

# Overstory vs pole count per plot ***NEED TO GET RID OF NAs
tree_df %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020, SizeClass) %>% summarise(Trees = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(x = SizeClass, y = Trees, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + facet_wrap(~ Plot) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Number of Overstory vs. Pole Trees per plot")

# Live vs. Dead Counts Per Plot
tree_df %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020, Status) %>% summarise(Trees = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(x = Status, y = Trees, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + facet_wrap(~Plot) + theme_minimal()+ labs(title = "Live vs. Dead Trees Per Plot")

# Tree Height Distribution
tree_df %>% filter(DBH > 15, !is.na(Height)) %>% ggplot(aes(x = Height, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") + facet_wrap(~ Plot) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Tree Height Distribution by Plot and Status", x = "Height (m)")

# Canopy Base Height
ggplot(tree_df, aes(x = Live.Crown.Base.Ht., fill = Burned2020)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, alpha = 0.7) + facet_wrap(~ Plot) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Canopy Base Height Distribution by Plot")

# Species Composition
tree_df %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020, Species) %>% summarise(Trees = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Species, -Trees), y = Trees, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + facet_wrap(~Plot) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Species Composition by Plot and Status", x = "Species") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Mortality / Fire Effects *GET RID OF NAs
tree_df %>% group_by(Burned2020, SizeClass) %>% summarise(Trees = n(), Dead = sum(Status =="D"), Mortality = Dead / Trees, .groups = "drop") %>% ggplot(aes(x = SizeClass, y = Mortality, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + labs(title = "Proportion of Dead Trees by Size Class")


ggplot(tree_df, aes(x = Burned2020, y = DBH, fill = Status)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~ Plot)+ theme_minimal() + labs(title = "DBH by Species and Status")

###Tree Report
tree_report <- tree_report %>% filter(Status =="PostBurn")
tree_report <- tree_report %>% select(-c(1, 3))

#Trees per Acre
tree_report %>% filter(Species =="All") %>% select(1:6) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(Plot, Burned2020, Species), names_to = "TreeClass", values_to = "Area") %>% ggplot(aes(x = TreeClass, y = Area, fill = Burned2020)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + facet_wrap(~Plot)

#Boxplot of Snag Density
tree_report %>% filter(Species == "All") %>% ggplot(aes(x = Burned2020, y = Live)) + geom_boxplot()


###Based on the above boxplot, doing a plot of snag density based on plot data not report data
sum1 <- tree_df %>% select(c(1:3, 8, 9, 11))
sum1 <- na.omit(sum1)
sum1 <- sum1 %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020, Status) %>% summarise(Trees = n(), meanDBH = mean(DBH)) %>% ungroup()

ggplot(sum1) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = Status, y = Trees)) + facet_wrap(~Burned2020)
```
